scopeNote: Records are declarations, parameter families, and script risk groups, not executed case counts.

reviewedDecisions.title: rejects arbitrary actions and stale loaded characters
reviewedDecisions.risk: 菜单动作必须来自当前已加载角色白名单；任意ID与角色切换后旧runtime都不能执行。

reviewedDecisions.title: allows the neutral expression reset but rejects unregistered expressions
reviewedDecisions.risk: 空ID是明确中性重置允许执行，未知表情或runtime未就绪拒绝且不发调用。

reviewedDecisions.title: does not apply a late motion result after the model changes
reviewedDecisions.risk: 异步动作结束时模型已替换，晚到成功不能改新提示、activeInteraction或触发旧setState。

reviewedDecisions.title: retains speech and reduced motion restrictions for menu actions
reviewedDecisions.risk: 语音口型进行中与reduced-motion状态分别禁止菜单动作；白名单通过不等于可打断语音。

reviewedDecisions.title: preserves overlapping additions from two stale windows and deduplicates IDs
reviewedDecisions.risk: 两个陈旧窗口同时追加同角色，锁内并集保留两方且共同mid不重复。

reviewedDecisions.title: clear defeats a delayed addition from the previous epoch without deleting another character
reviewedDecisions.risk: 清除epoch击败旧窗口未提交追加但保留另一角色；当前epoch新消息仍可写。

reviewedDecisions.title: accepts additions after a queued clear and preserves simultaneous clears of different characters
reviewedDecisions.risk: 同一队列先clear后add的新增不能被自己的墓碑吞掉，同时保留另一窗口不同角色clear。

reviewedDecisions.title: keeps failed writes retryable and does not publish a failed clear
reviewedDecisions.risk: 持久写失败不能发布清除结果，原归档字节不变且同操作可重试。

reviewedDecisions.title: fails closed without Web Locks while keeping the pending messages
reviewedDecisions.risk: 没有Web Locks时拒绝不安全并发保存并保留内存pending消息，不能静默降级写盘。

reviewedDecisions.title: invalidates queued operations on a global reset
reviewedDecisions.risk: 全局reset要使已排队保存失效，防止返回空状态后旧任务又写回归档。

reviewedDecisions.title: migrates legacy data once and never resurrects the retained source after a clear
reviewedDecisions.risk: 旧localStorage迁移只一次；权威IndexedDB清空后即使旧页面恢复legacy源也不能复活。

reviewedDecisions.title: retains an unsupported IndexedDB record without writing an empty replacement
reviewedDecisions.risk: 未来版本IndexedDB记录必须保留原结构且拒绝写入，不能当空归档覆盖。

reviewedDecisions.title: preserves temporarily unavailable characters through migration and edits and clears all of them explicitly
reviewedDecisions.risk: 暂不可用模型和新导入模型历史跨迁移/局部修改保留；显式全清才清它们。

reviewedDecisions.title: a clear-all covers characters first observed inside the lock
reviewedDecisions.risk: 过期窗口请求全清时需涵盖拿锁后才发现的新角色，不能只清本地缓存的id集合。

reviewedDecisions.title: refuses malformed authoritative records without overwriting them: %j
reviewedDecisions.risk: 缺archived、数组容器、非数组人物记录是不同坏形状，全部拒绝权威覆盖。

reviewedDecisions.title: does not fall back to legacy or empty data when the authoritative read fails
reviewedDecisions.risk: 权威读取异常不得退回legacy或空库，后续保存失败保留现有盘上归档。

reviewedDecisions.title: discards a queued draft when another window clears content, then accepts new input
reviewedDecisions.risk: 重置前已排队debounce不应写回旧草稿；重置之后新输入仍可保存。

reviewedDecisions.title: passes drawing draft status back to the model without rewarding a generated image
reviewedDecisions.risk: 绘画工具只生成draft时模型应拿到真实未出图回执，不增加生成图片的亲密度奖励。

reviewedDecisions.title: preserves received text when the connection ends unexpectedly
reviewedDecisions.risk: 流无done便关闭时保留已收文本、标stopped、报告中断并解除busy。

reviewedDecisions.title: cancels a pending native tool and never starts the next tool or chat round
reviewedDecisions.risk: 原生工具永不返回时取消仍需abort并结束busy，不执行第二工具或下一轮模型请求。

reviewedDecisions.title: sends captured screen pixels to the next model request
reviewedDecisions.risk: 截图工具的实际imageDataUrl必须进下一次模型messages，只有文字完成提示不足。

reviewedDecisions.title: returns invalid tool arguments as an error without executing the tool
reviewedDecisions.risk: 工具参数坏JSON应作为工具错误回复给模型且不执行工具；请求计数证明未发工具HTTP。

reviewedDecisions.title: does not resurrect a sent draft from the debounce timer
reviewedDecisions.risk: 已经发送的草稿不能被之前debounce复活，与清空/reset不同入口共享但必须接线取消。

reviewedDecisions.title: aborts a gateway tool request and prevents subsequent operations
reviewedDecisions.risk: 网关工具HTTP待返回期间stop应中断其signal并停止后续round，native IPC取消用例覆盖不了fetch路径。

reviewedDecisions.title: reports the tool round limit rather than presenting an empty successful reply
reviewedDecisions.risk: 连续工具轮达到4次上限要明确报错，不制造空成功助手回复或调用voice.finishTurn。

reviewedDecisions.title: keeps tool rounds on their submitted connection while metadata respects edited=%s
reviewedDecisions.risk: 工具round始终使用提交时地址/密钥/搜索选项；期间编辑表单则不能回写canonical模型，未编辑时应同步。

reviewedDecisions.title: reports only acknowledged host removal and rejects pre-acknowledgement reads
reviewedDecisions.risk: 清除host失败维持已配置；确认清除后更早读取晚到不能复活host模型/地址。

reviewedDecisions.title: keeps a newer personal editor intact when old save or clear work completes
reviewedDecisions.risk: 旧保存/清除完成不能关掉或覆盖已经修改的个人配置编辑器；只有当前操作可清密钥并发布成功提示。

reviewedDecisions.title: keeps new web keys in session memory, persists settings without keys and allows clearing
reviewedDecisions.risk: web密钥只留会话内存；非密钥设置可持久，重开能取会话密钥且明确清除后不复活。

reviewedDecisions.title: migrates legacy desktop values only after write and read-back succeed
reviewedDecisions.risk: desktop旧明文迁移必须等安全写入与回读成功再清本地源，过程中save不得提前抹除唯一凭据。

reviewedDecisions.title: preserves usable legacy values on %s failure, without exporting them
reviewedDecisions.risk: 安全写失败和写后校验失败都保留可用旧密钥但从backup排除；缺IndexedDB导出必须拒绝而非伪成功。

reviewedDecisions.title: refuses plaintext fallback when an older desktop bridge cannot save securely
reviewedDecisions.risk: 旧桌面bridge不提供安全存储时必须拒绝新密钥，不能退回localStorage明文。

reviewedDecisions.title: never migrates generated defaults over an existing secure credential
reviewedDecisions.risk: 已有安全凭据不能被自动生成的默认配置覆盖，且仅加载不制造本地写。

reviewedDecisions.title: does not resurrect a key scrubbed by another window while migration is blocked
reviewedDecisions.risk: 迁移阻塞期间另一窗口已清明文并添加消息，迟到迁移不能恢复旧key或覆盖新消息。

reviewedDecisions.title: does not migrate stale browser data over a concurrent save/clear (%s)
reviewedDecisions.risk: 用户保存新key与清空key两种状态均应优先于旧浏览器迁移，锁内不得再次写过期secret。

reviewedDecisions.title: keeps another window migration source when saving ordinary chat changes
reviewedDecisions.risk: 普通聊天修改不能清除另一窗口刚写入但尚未迁移的legacy key和endpoint。

reviewedDecisions.title: preserves default/host priority on reload and distinguishes a user key at the default endpoint
reviewedDecisions.risk: 默认或host回退不是用户配置；即使endpoint相同，用户主动存入安全key后重开必须标为用户配置。

reviewedDecisions.title: does not read or serialize message history or archives when typing or adjusting volume
reviewedDecisions.risk: 输入和音量调整不能序列化大消息/归档，volume边界钳制且独立键支持精确0和重开恢复。

reviewedDecisions.title: keeps cleared drafts and different-character edits through stale saves and history clears
reviewedDecisions.risk: 清草稿和跨角色草稿修改在陈旧save及历史清除后都不能丢失；独立volume也保留。

reviewedDecisions.title: clear reports failure and restores the in-memory history when persistence fails
reviewedDecisions.risk: 主记录清除写失败需false并恢复内存历史，避免界面提前显示清空。

reviewedDecisions.title: retains in-memory preferences and reports failed writes
reviewedDecisions.risk: 偏好写失败保留本地输入并逐次报告，恢复存储后save能把pending偏好补写。

reviewedDecisions.title: falls back to legacy preferences and ignores malformed optional records
reviewedDecisions.risk: 独立偏好键坏JSON/无效数值时回退合法legacy偏好，不能把坏可选记录升级成主库阻塞。

reviewedDecisions.title: exports separate preferences and preserves them when merging modern backups
reviewedDecisions.risk: 现代独立键备份在merge和replace均精确保留含空白JSON样草稿与0音量，不能错误解析草稿正文。

reviewedDecisions.title: restores legacy backup preferences over newer separate keys in merge and replace modes
reviewedDecisions.risk: 旧备份偏好在merge/replace都需覆盖新的独立键，否则导入看似成功但读出旧现值。

reviewedDecisions.title: rejects a failed restore without losing the archive and lets the same action retry
reviewedDecisions.risk: 活动聊天写失败时不丢当前消息或归档，拒绝并支持原操作重试合并。

reviewedDecisions.title: rejects a version-protected restore instead of reporting an empty archive
reviewedDecisions.risk: 在归档恢复入口遇未来主记录版本需明确拒绝而不是返回空归档/0项成功。

reviewedDecisions.title: waits for desktop confirmation and preserves a failed confirmation for retry
reviewedDecisions.risk: 桌面确认尚未返回不能提前成功；确认失败后保留已暂存消息与归档，重试不重复插入且再次等待确认。

reviewedDecisions.title: reports background synchronization read failures without erasing the current archive
reviewedDecisions.risk: 跨窗通知触发权威读失败要上报且保留当前归档数量，直接refresh拒绝不覆盖事件处理接线。

reviewedDecisions.title: imports and exports unavailable characters and rejects failed reads instead of exporting an empty archive
reviewedDecisions.risk: 未知角色归档能往返；导出/恢复读失败须拒绝而不输出假空库，显式清空包括未知角色。

reviewedDecisions.title: only writes on archive mutations and retries an archive write failure on save
reviewedDecisions.risk: 超活动消息上限时归档写失败不得先删主历史；后续save重试成功后仅归档变更写库，普通save不重复归档。

reviewedDecisions.title: preserves malformed JSON and refuses writes instead of replacing the original
reviewedDecisions.risk: 损坏主JSON必须保留原件、拒绝写并报告错误，不能以空状态替换。

reviewedDecisions.title: preserves a zero-revision character update after clearing another character
reviewedDecisions.risk: 清宁宁后夏目零revision新增仍需保留；不能把全局代次当全部角色的墓碑。

reviewedDecisions.title: does not resurrect either character after interleaved clears and stale saves
reviewedDecisions.risk: 两个窗口分别清两个角色，第三个旧窗口save不能复活任一清除内容。

reviewedDecisions.title: preserves disk and loaded messages when normalization writeback fails once
reviewedDecisions.risk: 规范化回写配额失败不能丢已经读到的消息或改坏盘上原件，下次保存仍可成功。

reviewedDecisions.title: retains streaming message and array identity across another window append
reviewedDecisions.risk: 合并另一窗口新消息时必须保留当前流式消息及数组对象身份，后续token继续写到实际记录。

reviewedDecisions.title: adopts remote token updates even when history length is unchanged
reviewedDecisions.risk: 相同消息数量下另一窗口token更新也需合并，同时不替换接收侧已有消息引用。

reviewedDecisions.title: keeps locally modified tokens when a remote stale copy adds a message
reviewedDecisions.risk: 本地未保存token相对远程旧副本优先，但仍接受远程追加的新消息。

reviewedDecisions.title: persists a real conversation stream through a cross-window save and reload
reviewedDecisions.risk: 真实ReadableStream边生成边跨窗口保存，最终用户消息/完整回复/外窗追加都保留且忙态释放；前面直接修改对象不能证明stream接线。

reviewedDecisions.title: migrates supported chat version %s with messages intact
reviewedDecisions.risk: 无version和v1/v2/v3均保留消息升到当前v3，参数家族覆盖各受支持来源版本。

reviewedDecisions.title: rejects unsupported version %s without touching any key
reviewedDecisions.risk: 未来版本、字符串版本、null、负数、非整数必须阻断全部写入口并保留原始字节，不能读成空库后覆盖。

reviewedDecisions.title: rejects another window upgrading the record after load
reviewedDecisions.risk: 加载之后另一窗口升级成未来版本，也要在写入时重新检查，启动检查不能覆盖这场竞争。

reviewedDecisions.title: protects archive and memory versions and replace-mode restore
reviewedDecisions.risk: 独立归档、记忆版本和replace备份路径也须保护未来格式，不能只保护聊天主记录。

reviewedDecisions.title: cancels manual recording on %s without submitting it
reviewedDecisions.risk: blur、DOM hidden、原生hidden三条独立事件入口需取消手动录音且不提交转写。

reviewedDecisions.title: cancels capture as soon as the character starts replying
reviewedDecisions.risk: 人物开始busy回复应立即取消已按下的手动capture，不等待音频播放或窗口失焦。

reviewedDecisions.title: resumes continuous listening after reply and TTS finish
reviewedDecisions.risk: 唤醒自动发送后busy与speaking分别暂停连续监听，二者结束恢复并允许第二次relay。

reviewedDecisions.title: accepts a second manual transcript when auto-send is disabled
reviewedDecisions.risk: 桌面聊天在autoSend关闭时第二段手动转写替换草稿且不调用IPC发送。
reviewedDecisions.duplicates: browser重复草稿矩阵测useCompanionSpeechInput，未验证desktop chat的输入接线。

reviewedDecisions.title: can wake again after an end phrase without a chat reply
reviewedDecisions.risk: 结束短语不产生模型回复时仍能重新唤醒，不能永久卡在等待回复状态。

reviewedDecisions.title: mounts $entry with speech disabled after a storage $failure failure
reviewedDecisions.risk: 三个入口遇profile getItem拒绝，以及Storage getter不可用时均安全禁用语音、保留原记录且不写；已确认配置能直接恢复而无需重读失败存储。

reviewedDecisions.title: accepts repeated drafts with wake=%s
reviewedDecisions.risk: 浏览陪伴的手动与唤醒两家族都接受连续草稿，结束短语后允许新会话；分别覆盖auto/manual来源。

reviewedDecisions.title: keeps a reader position and offers an explicit return to latest
reviewedDecisions.risk: 用户停在旧消息时新增回复只提示hasNew，显式latest才滚底并清标记；初始化滚底不覆盖正在阅读的位置策略。

reviewedDecisions.title: stays chrome-free on hover and opens controls only explicitly
reviewedDecisions.risk: 悬停不弹控件，只有右键打开且Escape关闭，避免桌宠长期挡住桌面。

reviewedDecisions.title: starts a native drag only after dragging the model, never from a control
reviewedDecisions.risk: 模型按下后小移动不拖原生窗，超过阈值只发一次；控件上的拖动不能夺取窗口。

reviewedDecisions.title: opens chat on model double click but not on controls
reviewedDecisions.risk: 双击模型打开聊天，双击按钮不打开；与单击原生拖动是不同事件分支。

reviewedDecisions.title: bounds corrupt or extreme saved framing without accepting NaN or strings
reviewedDecisions.risk: 缺记录保留基准；Infinity/NaN回退，越界位置和zoom钳制，防坏存储把人物移出画面。

reviewedDecisions.title: keeps saved room calibration and the independent companion calibration until explicit reset
reviewedDecisions.risk: room和companion分别恢复同角色校准，重置房间不能覆盖陪伴窗口的用户坐标。

reviewedDecisions.title: changing characters reads their defaults without overwriting existing persisted choices
reviewedDecisions.risk: 只切换未知/另一角色时应显示默认框位且不凭空写入用户校准记录。

reviewedDecisions.title: persists only planning facts, preserves zero seed and restores accepted work as unknown
reviewedDecisions.risk: 持久计划排除临时blob/进度文本，保留0 seed和accepted身份；恢复accepted为unknown而不能重新提交。

reviewedDecisions.title: does not turn corrupt or duplicate identities into executable jobs
reviewedDecisions.risk: 未知版本、重复requestKey与坏JSON不能产生可执行作业；坏原件必须留存而非清掉。

reviewedDecisions.title: registers window planning as draft and layout as a restorable setting
reviewedDecisions.risk: 批次计划是窗口session草稿不应混入全局local备份，director布局反而必须可恢复为setting。

reviewedDecisions.title: 初始化不上传图片，确认后保留工作室角色、遮罩与完整生成参数
reviewedDecisions.risk: 初始零上传；确认后图+手绘mask按原角色/LoRA/尺寸提交，parentId保留且拥有原图URL活到scope退出。

reviewedDecisions.title: freezes model and LoRA state before the asynchronous source upload
reviewedDecisions.risk: source上传在途改变模型/LoRA不能污染当前换装的冻结recipe。

reviewedDecisions.title: keeps an external source explicitly parentless even if the caller changes its draft during preparation
reviewedDecisions.risk: 明确外部源parentId=null不能被等待期间后来填入的历史ID替换。

reviewedDecisions.title: 热门角色沿用无 LoRA 绑定、身份与自动遮罩参数
reviewedDecisions.risk: 热门身份不能被characterOverride带回studio，选择no-LoRA底模并保留自动mask参数、无角色LoRA和安全负向。

reviewedDecisions.title: 错误引擎不上传，上传失败不提交并保留重试弹窗
reviewedDecisions.risk: 错误引擎零上传；上传失败零生成、清楚报错且弹窗保留重试。

reviewedDecisions.title: preparation is single-flight and rejects late uploads after closing, changing engine or disposing
reviewedDecisions.risk: 准备期重复提交单飞；关闭于冷加载/上传阶段、换引擎、dispose各边界使signal失效，迟到上传不得生成或留原图URL。

reviewedDecisions.title: retains Krea runtime style processing, actual parameters and result context
reviewedDecisions.risk: Krea运行时返回风格处理与实际参数进入结果，context进入专属字段而不泄漏进metadata。

reviewedDecisions.title: a late durable cancellation receipt cannot roll a completed image back to cancelling
reviewedDecisions.risk: 同一任务已完成出图后旧取消确认不能把成功结果退回cancelled/cancelling。

reviewedDecisions.title: a stale durable cancellation failure cannot overwrite a newer generation
reviewedDecisions.risk: 新的generation已开始时旧取消失败不能改其任何state字段。

reviewedDecisions.title: cleans up a late accepted job through its original engine after a cross-engine retry
reviewedDecisions.risk: 跨引擎重试后旧Anima迟到接单必须按旧Anima路由DELETE，不能误删Krea新任务。

reviewedDecisions.title: clears failed-job ownership before retrying and keeps submission cancellation usable
reviewedDecisions.risk: 失败job/id/node在新提交前清空，随后的取消作用于新POST及迟到新ID，不是previous-job。

reviewedDecisions.title: `ignores a delayed cancellation ${outcome} after a new generation starts`
reviewedDecisions.risk: 旧DELETE成功和拒绝两家族均不得覆盖新提交的phase/status/error。

reviewedDecisions.title: does not replace a terminal success with a delayed cancellation acknowledgement
reviewedDecisions.risk: Web同一job已成功时迟到DELETE确认不能改变终态提示；runtime用例不是同一传输实现。

reviewedDecisions.title: invalidates an in-flight progress read once DELETE confirms cancellation
reviewedDecisions.risk: 引擎面板切换也不改已接任务路由；DELETE确认使在途进度失效且仅一次删除。

reviewedDecisions.title: keeps a restored result when a cancelled submission resolves late
reviewedDecisions.risk: 用户取消新提交并恢复前图后，迟到接单清理不能抹掉已恢复结果/提示。

reviewedDecisions.title: `ignores an older backend status ${outcome} after a newer refresh succeeds`
reviewedDecisions.risk: 两个并发发现请求中最新成功后，旧离线成功或旧网络失败都不能改online/model。

reviewedDecisions.title: waits for replacement discovery when the superseded request ends with %s first
reviewedDecisions.risk: 被替代请求先结束时其调用者仍应等待替代发现并拿同一个成功结果，而非过早返回旧失败。

reviewedDecisions.title: discards a backend response after status polling is paused
reviewedDecisions.risk: 暂停状态轮询需abort在途发现；迟到离线结果不改现有state且请求返回false。

reviewedDecisions.title: dispose cancels %s ownership and deletes a late or already accepted job
reviewedDecisions.risk: 旧Web提交中/已运行两阶段退出均需删除相应晚到或已接ID，停止全部timer且不再更新state。

reviewedDecisions.title: keeps the default MiaoMiao 1.6 offline rather than silently substituting an older available model
reviewedDecisions.risk: 默认1.6离线不能擅自用旧1.2替代；用户明确选择旧可用模型后才online。

reviewedDecisions.title: 底模未发生改变的心跳轮询不覆写用户手动调整的 cfg、steps 与已选风格 LoRA
reviewedDecisions.risk: 首次Krea状态应用底模参数且清人物LoRA；同模型后续心跳不能覆盖用户cfg/steps/styleLora。

reviewedDecisions.title: converges unsupported sizes and keeps character versus no-LoRA inpaint binding coherent
reviewedDecisions.risk: 非支持尺寸按模型收敛；人物LoRA与no-LoRA换装选择不同底模，没有no-LoRA能力时拒绝绑定。

reviewedDecisions.title: omits unset transport fields and never overrides an explicit denied adult authorization
reviewedDecisions.risk: 可选字段未设置省略，显式seed/LoRA=0保留；远程和显式拒绝adult不能被本机默认升级授权。
